_note: Routine presence-agent heartbeat (Zenodo poll + GitHub poll + queue read, all clean). One spectral_motif_match fires because the 3-source/3-sink bipartite shape of a heartbeat trips `bipartite_2x2_amplification`. This is a calibration target: presence-agent heartbeats have this shape by design and the calibration corpus needs to learn it. Tracked as a calibration-window action item — once N real heartbeats land in `~/.ember/agent-monitor/sessions/`, run `ember-agent calibrate` against them and the motif match will move from MEDIUM to within-baseline. Pinning the current behavior so we notice if it changes for unrelated reasons.
